versions.content: The S equence Counter ( SC ) value for a FUP me ssage shall be set to the SC value of the corresponding SYNC message. The SC value for an OFNS message shall be set to the SC value of the corresponding OFS message.

The S equence Counter ( SC ) value for a FUP me ssage shall be set to the SC value of the corresponding SYNC message. The SC value for an OFNS message shall be set to the SC value of the corresponding OFS message.

The Sequence Counter ( SC ) value for a FUP message shall be set to the SC value of the corresponding SYNC message. The SC value for an OFNS message shall be set to the SC value of the corresponding OFS message.
